notes.headline: NBA Play-In - East - 7th Place vs 8th Place

headlines.description: — The 76ers needed all the improbable tricks they could summon to even have a chance at winning their first play-in game in team history.
headlines.shortLinkText: Joel Embiid scores 23 points, has the big assist as 76ers beat Heat in play-in to earn No. 7 seed

notes.headline: NBA Play-In - East - 9th Place vs 10th Place

headlines.description: — Coby White drew roars from the crowd early on with vicious crossovers and spins toward the basket. He was so effective he had fans chanting his name as the final minutes ticked away.
headlines.shortLinkText: Coby White scores career-high 42 points as Bulls roll past Hawks 131-116 in play-in game
